crossRefs.note: They came to Jacob their father, to the land of Canaan, and told him all that had happened to them, saying,

translations.web: When we came up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
translations.bsb: Now when we returned to your servant my father, we relayed your words to him.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
translations.asv: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
